overview.description: The Defiance Daily Target 2X Long SPCX ETF (SPCU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund seeks to deliver 2x leveraged exposure to the daily share price movements of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A (NASDAQ: SPCX), less fees and expenses, through derivatives such as options and swap agreements. SPCU was launched on Jun 12, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
